propositions: Phase-3 remediation proposals lack validation against prior project decisions and reachable harms, allowing invalid or reversing moves to reach Phase-4 approval unflagged
Two blind parallel proposers read identical evidence but their agreement measures prompt stability rather than correctness without independent grounding
Findings must pass a fifth validity sub-question (harm_reachable) requiring concrete triggering inputs and reclassify to HARDENING if harm is unreachable, not bypassing existing floors

Prior deliberate decisions must be surfaced with classification (explicit_justified, explicit_bare, incidental, none) and incur -0.10 validity penalty on reversals unless evidence_changed is documented

Phase-3 proposers must be asymmetric: Proposer A researches OSS best practices, Proposer B researches project record; unconverged moves trigger divergence research resolving to research-resolved or no-consensus with explicit bucket-weighting
